chunks: As for what ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan narrated from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Zurārah, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿUbayd Allāh al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, concerning:

A menstruating woman—what is lawful for her husband from her? He said: She should wrap herself with a waist-wrapper up to the knees and expose her navel; then for him is what is above the waist-wrapper.

key_terms.بِإِزَارٍ: with an izar, a lower-body covering cloth
key_terms.تَتَّزِرُ: she wraps herself with a waist-wrapper

ai.seo_question: What is permissible for a husband with his menstruating wife according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling regarding what is permissible between a husband and his menstruating wife. It specifies a boundary of physical intimacy by instructing that she cover herself with an izar to the knees, after which what is above the izar is lawful for him.
